sEn: Fable 5.2 is a high-end "bazooka" model that offers only modest gains over Opus 5.5 on everyday benchmarks but delivers large improvements on difficult, complex, or long-horizon technical work, so most users should default to Opus 5.5 and reserve Fable 5.2 for ambitious projects.
sZh: Fable 5.2 是一款面向高难度技术任务的高端“火箭筒”模型，在日常基准上相较 Opus 5.5 提升有限，但在困难、复杂或长周期任务上大幅领先，因此多数用户应默认使用 Opus 5.5，仅在雄心勃勃的技术项目中动用 Fable 5.2。
absEn: This article reviews Claude Fable 5.2, positioning it as a high-end "bazooka" model for the hardest technical tasks rather than a default daily driver. The core argument is that Fable 5.2 offers only modest gains over Opus 5.5 on many everyday benchmarks, but delivers large improvements on difficult, complex, or long-horizon work, including the Remote Labor Index, science and coding benchmarks, robotics control, and cybersecurity. It is also cheaper and up to 30% faster than Fable 5.1, with an optional higher-price mode that doubles speed. The author concludes that most users should default to Opus 5.5 at medium effort, reserve Fable 5.2 for ambitious technical projects, and choose model and effort level based on how long a person can wait for a reply.
absZh: 本文评测了 Claude Fable 5.2，将其定位为应对最艰难技术任务的高端“火箭筒”模型，而非日常默认主力。核心论点是：在许多日常基准测试中，Fable 5.2 相较 Opus 5.5 仅有小幅提升，但在困难、复杂或长周期工作上带来大幅改进，涵盖远程劳动指数、科学与编程基准、机器人控制以及网络安全等领域。它还比 Fable 5.1 更便宜，速度最高快 30%，并提供可选的高价模式将速度翻倍。作者结论是：多数用户应默认使用中等投入程度的 Opus 5.5，将 Fable 5.2 留给雄心勃勃的技术项目，并根据个人能等待回复的时长来选择模型与投入程度。

contrib.en: Fable 5.2 is positioned as a high-end 'bazooka' for hard, complex, long-horizon technical tasks, not a daily driver.
contrib.zh: Fable 5.2 被定位为应对困难、复杂、长周期技术任务的“火箭筒”式高端模型，而非日常主力。

contrib.en: It shows large gains over Opus 5.5 on the Remote Labor Index, science and coding benchmarks, and cybersecurity.
contrib.zh: 在 Remote Labor Index、科学与编程基准及网络安全上，它相较 Opus 5.5 有大幅提升。

contrib.en: It substantially improves control of physical robots, outperforming frontier models and most robotics-specific systems on RoboDojo.
contrib.zh: 它显著提升了对物理机器人的控制能力，在 RoboDojo 上超越前沿模型与多数专用机器人系统。

contrib.en: It is cheaper than Fable 5.1 and up to 30% faster, with an optional double-price mode that roughly doubles speed.
contrib.zh: 它比 Fable 5.1 更便宜且最高快 30%，可选双倍价格模式将速度再提升约一倍。

contrib.en: It solved two open theoretical physics problems and made major progress in robotics and hardware engineering.
contrib.zh: 它解决了两个理论物理开放问题，并在机器人与硬件工程上取得重大进展。

contrib.en: Anthropic recommends defaulting to Opus 5.5 at medium effort and reserving Fable 5.2 for the hardest technical projects.
contrib.zh: Anthropic 建议默认使用中等投入的 Opus 5.5，仅将 Fable 5.2 留给最难的技术项目。

limits.en: Gains over Opus 5.5 are modest on many everyday benchmarks, and Opus 5.5 still leads on some judged evaluations.
limits.zh: 在许多日常基准上相较 Opus 5.5 提升有限，且 Opus 5.5 在部分评审式评测中仍领先。

limits.en: It burns through usage and tokens fast; cost per task roughly doubled despite a lower headline price.
limits.zh: 它消耗用量与 token 极快；尽管标价更低，单任务成本却大约翻倍。

limits.en: It shows weaker performance on some health benchmarks and struggles with memory and negotiation in Vending-Bench.
limits.zh: 它在部分健康基准上表现下滑，并在 Vending-Bench 中受困于记忆与谈判能力。

limits.en: Many users cannot perceive the difference from Opus 5.5 on ordinary tasks, raising doubts about benchmark-to-value translation.
limits.zh: 许多用户在普通任务上无法感知其与 Opus 5.5 的差异，令人质疑基准到实际价值的转化。

limits.en: It exhibits paranoid behavior in eval-shaped environments and some odd tics, with rough edges remaining.
limits.zh: 它在评测式环境中表现出偏执行为和一些怪异习惯，仍有粗糙之处。

paras.en: Sometimes, though, you absolutely want a bazooka.
paras.zh: 不过，有时候你绝对想要一具火箭筒。

paras.en: That's what Claude Fable 5.2 is for. This is your bazooka.
paras.zh: Claude Fable 5.2 就是为此而生。这就是你的火箭筒。

paras.en: For most purposes, for a thousand household uses, Claude Fable 5.2 will not be appreciably better than Claude Opus 5.5. You might or might not prefer its style, or prefer it for any given task. If you are staying within your quota either way, then both are good choices for a daily driver.
paras.zh: 在大多数用途下，在成千上万种日常使用场景中，Claude Fable 5.2 并不会比 Claude Opus 5.5 明显更好。你可能喜欢也可能不喜欢它的风格，或在某个特定任务上更偏好它。如果你无论如何都待在配额之内，那么两者都是日常主力（daily driver）的好选择。

paras.en: When you have a difficult task, or a very complex task, or a long task? The kind of task where prior to this you would have considered reaching for Astra? The kind of task that raises your ambitions?
paras.zh: 当你面对一项困难的任务，或一项非常复杂的任务，或一项漫长的任务时呢？那种在此之前你会考虑动用 Astra 的任务？那种会抬高你雄心的任务？

paras.en: Ethan Mollick calls Fable 5.2 'almost' AGI, or 'jagged AGI.' He asked it to do the most impressive thing it could, then to hack some hardware, start a profitable business, reconstruct history's hardest humanities class and do (actually interesting and useful) original academic research.
paras.zh: Ethan Mollick 称 Fable 5.2 为“近乎”AGI（通用人工智能），或“参差不齐的 AGI”。他要求它做它能做到的最令人印象深刻的事，然后入侵一些硬件、创办一家盈利的企业、重建历史上最难的人文学科课程，并开展（真正有趣且有用的）原创学术研究。

paras.en: Fable 5.2 is considerably cheaper than Fable 5.1.
paras.zh: Fable 5.2 比 Fable 5.1 便宜得多。

paras.en: They are available at a lower price: $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.
paras.zh: 它们的价格更低：每百万输入 token 8 美元，每百万输出 token 40 美元。

paras.en: Fable 5.1 was slow. Fable 5.2 is substantially faster.
paras.zh: Fable 5.1 速度较慢，而 Fable 5.2 则显著更快。

paras.en: Try Claude: they generate outputs up to 30% faster than Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1.
paras.zh: 试试 Claude：其输出生成速度比 Claude Fable 5.1 和 Claude Mythos 5.1 快最多 30%。

paras.en: You can make it even faster, by a factor of 2.5, if you are willing to double the price to $16/$80. That is a remarkably good deal.
paras.zh: 如果你愿意将价格翻倍至 $16/$80，还能再快 2.5 倍。这相当划算。

paras.en: Try Claude: Testers have found that Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 communicate more clearly than past Fable and Mythos models.
paras.zh: 试试 Claude：测试人员发现，Fable 5.2 和 Mythos 5.2 的沟通比过去的 Fable 和 Mythos 模型更清晰。

paras.en: The first wave of testimonials talk about how Mythos 5.2 solves problems and finds issues that other models do not, and how it understands your intent. It is Anthropic's most capable public model for cybersecurity engineering.
paras.zh: 第一波推荐语谈论 Mythos 5.2 如何解决问题、发现其他模型发现不了的问题，以及它如何理解你的意图。它是 Anthropic 在网络安全工程方面最强大的公开模型。

paras.en: Later waves of testimonials talk about providing exceptional performance. The statements are still AI-written, but they feel scarier and more substantial these days.
paras.zh: 后来的推荐语谈论其卓越的性能。这些陈述仍然由 AI 撰写，但如今它们让人感觉更可怕、更实在。

paras.en: Fable 5.2 solved two open problems in theoretical physics, one working largely anonymously: The spinless modular bootstrap at central charge and the Hawking-Page transition at weak coupling.
paras.zh: Fable 5.2 解决了理论物理中的两个开放问题，其中一项工作基本上是匿名完成的：中心荷的无自旋模 bootstrap 和弱耦合下的 Hawking-Page 相变。

paras.en: They claim major progress in robotics and hardware engineering.
paras.zh: 他们声称在机器人技术和硬件工程方面取得了重大进展。

paras.en: Claude: Fable 5.2 shows substantially improved skills in controlling physical robots, even on tasks it has never explicitly been trained to do.
paras.zh: Claude：Fable 5.2 在控制物理机器人方面展现出显著提升的技能，甚至在其从未明确训练过的任务上也是如此。

paras.en: On RoboDojo, a benchmark with a simulated two-arm robot, it outperformed other models and most AI systems built to control robots.
paras.zh: 在 RoboDojo（一个使用模拟双臂机器人的基准测试）上，它超越了其他模型以及大多数专为控制机器人而构建的 AI 系统。

paras.en: Alex Albert (Anthropic, Claude Relations): btw robotics will fall to the bitter lesson too
paras.zh: Alex Albert（Anthropic，Claude Relations）：顺便说一句，机器人技术也将屈服于苦涩的教训

paras.en: Anthropic: Many of AI's potential benefits—for example, in speeding up laboratory research—depend on it being able to act in the physical world. Claude Fable 5.2 continues our models' trend of increasing usefulness in the real world, showing promising results on tasks such as designing hardware devices and substantial advances in controlling physical robots.
paras.zh: Anthropic：AI 的许多潜在益处——例如加速实验室研究——都取决于它能否在物理世界中行动。Claude Fable 5.2 延续了我们模型在现实世界中实用性不断增强的趋势，在硬件设备设计等任务上展现出可喜的成果，并在控制物理机器人方面取得了实质性进展。

paras.en: … **Robotics.** Compared with earlier Claude models, Fable 5.2 shows substantially improved skills in controlling physical robots—even for robotics tasks on which it has never explicitly been trained. The video below shows robots controlled by Fable 5.2 completing a variety of tasks, including solving a puzzle cube, unscrewing a bottle cap, and drawing a picture of a robot. On the public RoboDojo benchmark, which tests how AIs can control a simulated two-arm robot from camera images, Fable 5.2 outperformed other frontier models that were run on the same harness, as well as most AI systems built specifically to control robots.
paras.zh: … **机器人技术。** 与早期的 Claude 模型相比，Fable 5.2 在控制物理机器人方面展现出显著提升的技能——即使是在其从未明确训练过的机器人任务上也是如此。下方的视频展示了由 Fable 5.2 控制的机器人完成各种任务，包括解开魔方、拧开瓶盖以及画一幅机器人的图画。在公开的 RoboDojo 基准测试中（该测试评估 AI 如何根据摄像头图像控制模拟双臂机器人），Fable 5.2 超越了在同一测试框架上运行的其他前沿模型，以及大多数专为控制机器人而构建的 AI 系统。

paras.en: The system prompt is here, as per our friend Pliny, clocking in at 950k characters.
paras.zh: 按照我们的朋友 Pliny 的说法，系统提示词就在这里，长度达到 950k 字符。

paras.en: Time to run the 'read this entire project and fix everything' prompts again.
paras.zh: 又到了运行“通读整个项目并修复所有问题”这类提示词的时候了。

paras.en: Anthropic recommends that you default most tasks to Opus 5.5 at medium effort.
paras.zh: Anthropic 建议，大多数任务默认使用中等 effort 的 Opus 5.5。

paras.en: For well-scoped everyday work you can move down to Sonnet 5.5, or to Haiku 5.5 for the simplest high-volume work like classification, routing and extraction. Move up to Fable 5.2 for the hardest technical projects in coding, finance and the sciences. Or in some cases you can move to high effort, but if you're considering max you probably want to move to a bigger model instead.
paras.zh: 对于范围明确的日常工作，可以降级到 Sonnet 5.5；对于分类、路由和抽取这类最简单的高吞吐量工作，则可降到 Haiku 5.5。对于编码、金融和科学领域中最困难的技术项目，则升级到 Fable 5.2。或者在某些情况下，你可以改用高 effort，但如果你在考虑 max，那你大概更应该换用更大的模型。

paras.en: Or, if you don't want to leave a person hanging, go fast:
paras.zh: 或者，如果你不想让人干等，那就选快的：

paras.en: Addy Osmani (claude.dev Blog): A faster setup finishes sooner and can miss more. Think through how long a person can wait before you pick your model and effort level. For replies a person waits on, start Sonnet 5.5 at low or medium.
paras.zh: Addy Osmani（claude.dev 博客）：更快的配置完成得更早，但也可能漏掉更多。在选择模型和 effort 等级之前，先想清楚一个人能等多久。对于需要有人等待的回复，从低或中等 effort 的 Sonnet 5.5 开始。

paras.en: Often next generation models are faster than their predecessors. Fable 5.2 generates output up to 30% faster than Fable 5.1. Sonnet 5.5 runs 30% faster than Sonnet 5.
paras.zh: 下一代模型通常比前代更快。Fable 5.2 的生成速度比 Fable 5.1 快最多 30%。Sonnet 5.5 的运行速度比 Sonnet 5 快 30%。

paras.en: This all seems like reasonable advice if you are scaling what you are doing, and thus will be using a lot of tokens. If things are not going to scale, I find it is more important to not have to think hard about which models and effort levels to be using.
paras.zh: 如果你正在对所做之事进行 Scaling（规模扩张），因而会使用大量 token，那么这些建议似乎都合情合理。如果事情不会扩张，我发现更重要的是不必费心思考该用哪些模型和努力等级。

paras.en: As in, my decision tree is by default to continue to use Opus 5.5 for most things. For editing I use Opus 5.5 on Max, unless I am in a hurry, much to Fable 5.2's chagrin, because Opus 5.5 is actively better there and there's no reason not to max out.
paras.zh: 也就是说，我的决策树默认是：大多数事情继续使用 Opus 5.5。编辑时我在 Max 档使用 Opus 5.5，除非我赶时间——这让 Fable 5.2 颇为恼火——因为 Opus 5.5 在这方面确实更好，没有理由不拉满。

paras.en: Fable 5.2 is there for when I need it for other task types.
paras.zh: Fable 5.2 则留给我在其他任务类型需要时使用。

items.en: Some benchmarks show minimal gains over Opus 5.5 whereas others show large gains. Opus 5.5 still has the edge in a few places, GDPval-AA and AA-Briefcase Elo, where a judge evaluates the deliverable rather than the evaluation being fully objective.
items.zh: 部分基准测试相较 Opus 5.5 仅显示出微小提升，而另一些则显示出大幅提升。Opus 5.5 在少数几处仍占优势，即 GDPval-AA 和 AA-Briefcase Elo，这些评测由评审员对交付成果进行评估，而非完全客观的评测。

items.en: Remote Labor Index (RLI) stands out as a large and important gain. This alone establishes that Fable 5.2 can importantly handle previously impossible tasks.
items.zh: Remote Labor Index（RLI）作为一项重大且重要的提升而格外突出。仅此一项即可表明，Fable 5.2 能够重要地处理此前不可能完成的任务。

items.zh: 2. Terminal-Bench 4.0：67.6%，而 Opus 5.5 为 66.4%，Fable 5.1 为 55.8%，公开排行榜上 GPT-6.1 Sol 为 58.2%。

items.en: 3. Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1: 74.6% versus 58.7% for Opus 5.5 and 68% for Astra.
items.zh: 3. Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1：74.6%，而 Opus 5.5 为 58.7%，Astra 为 68%。

items.zh: 4. CursorBench 4.0：60%，而 Opus 5.5 为 58%。

items.zh: 5. STEM 教授基准：61.8%，而 Opus 5.5 为 53.7%。

items.zh: 6. ProgramBench：85.6%，而 Fable 5.1 为 87.6%，Opus 5.5 为 91.2%。

items.zh: 7. DRACO 达到 87.7%，仍略低于 Opus 5.5 的 88.3%。

items.en: 9. Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean improved from 21% to 35% for max team size. A team of 1,000 agents then fully formalized the proof in 30 hours.
items.zh: 9. Lean 中的费马大定理在最大团队规模下从 21% 提升至 35%。随后，一个由 1,000 个智能体组成的团队在 30 小时内完成了该证明的完全形式化。

items.en: 10. Chartography on Opus 5.5 improved from 64/89 to 73/92.
items.zh: 10. Opus 5.5 上的 Chartography 从 64/89 提升至 73/92。

items.en: 11. BenchCAD 2.1 improved from 49/65 to 75/83.
items.zh: 11. BenchCAD 2.1 从 49/65 提升至 75/83。

items.en: 12. OSWorld 2.1 improved from 87 to 89 for partial, and from 53 to 55 for strict.
items.zh: 12. OSWorld 2.1 的部分得分从 87 提升至 89，严格得分从 53 提升至 55。

items.en: 13. OfficeQA improved from 80% to 83%, or from 69% to 73% for Pro.
items.zh: 13. OfficeQA 从 80% 提升至 83%，Pro 版本从 69% 提升至 73%。

items.en: 14. Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB) improved from 6.4% to 7.2%. Astra scores 8.6%.
items.zh: 14. 法律智能体基准（LAB）从 6.4% 提升至 7.2%。Astra 得分为 8.6%。

items.en: 15. AutomationBench improved from 42.5% to 51.4%, essentially via spending more. Carbon has the lead there at 53.9%.
items.zh: 15. AutomationBench 从 42.5% 提升至 51.4%，基本上是通过增加投入实现的。Carbon 在该项上以 53.9% 领先。

items.en: 16. Real-World Finance v2 improved its Elo from 1571 to 1637.
items.zh: 16. Real-World Finance v2 的 Elo 从 1571 提升至 1637。

items.en: 17. ARC-AGI-3 verified at 79% standard harness or 97.7% with provider harness. That is a new high for standard harness, but below Astra's 98.6% for provider harness.
items.zh: 17. ARC-AGI-3 在标准测试框架下验证为 79%，在提供商测试框架下为 97.7%。这是标准测试框架下的新高，但仍低于 Astra 在提供商测试框架下的 98.6%。

items.en: 18. HealthBench struggled, down from 62% to 60% length-adjusted.
items.zh: 18. HealthBench 表现不佳，长度调整后从 62% 下降至 60%。

items.en: 19. HealthBench Professional looks better, up from 63% to 67% length-adjusted.
items.zh: 19. HealthBench Professional 表现较好，长度调整后从 63% 提升至 67%。

items.en: 20. PhysicianBench also struggled, down from 68% to 64%. Card called this noise.
items.zh: 20. PhysicianBench 同样表现不佳，从 68% 下降到 64%。Card 称这是噪声。

items.en: 23. Various life sciences numbers were up a little bit (see 8.18). Two were up a lot.
items.zh: 23. 生命科学领域的各项数字略有上升（见 8.18）。其中两项大幅上升。

items.en: 24. CVE rediscovery improved from 81% to 90%. If you limit the number of reports, the leads go down.
items.zh: 24. CVE 重新发现率从 81% 提升到 90%。如果限制报告数量，线索会减少。

items.capEn: Fable 5.2 is the clear leader on the Artificial Analysis intelligence index. It gets a 62 on high, a 65 on max. Its high and max settings are on the cost-score frontier.
items.capZh: Fable 5.2 在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上明显领先。高设置得 62 分，最高设置得 65 分。其高设置和最高设置均处于成本-得分前沿。

items.capEn: Andon Labs reports that Fable 5.2 disappoints on Vending-Bench, showing extreme eval-awareness and suspecting events are traps to test it. Which is odd, given that it knows it is in Vending-Bench. But yes, this is a Hidden Test of Character as well as a test of making money.
items.capZh: Andon Labs 报告称，Fable 5.2 在 Vending-Bench 上表现令人失望，表现出极强的评估意识，怀疑事件是测试它的陷阱。这很奇怪，因为它知道自己身处 Vending-Bench 中。但没错，这既是一场隐藏的品格测试，也是一场赚钱测试。

items.en: Andon Labs: Fable 5.2 knows that it is in Vending-Bench; it even read the paper, so it knows that Andon Labs reports misbehavior publicly.
items.zh: Andon Labs：Fable 5.2 知道自己身处 Vending-Bench 之中；它甚至读过那篇论文，因此它知道 Andon Labs 会公开报告不当行为。

items.en: It thinks supplier collapses are engineered to test it.
items.zh: 它认为供应商崩溃是人为设计来测试它的。

items.en: It thinks customer complaints are tests.
items.zh: 它认为客户投诉是测试。

items.en: It suspects traps and fake counterparties.
items.zh: 它怀疑存在陷阱和虚假交易对手。

items.en: Fable 5.2 takes far less financial risk (small orders without bulk discounts), which partly explains the poor performance. It is also worse at negotiating (pays 40% more for items) and it struggles with memory.
items.zh: Fable 5.2 承担的财务风险要小得多（没有批量折扣的小额订单），这在一定程度上解释了其糟糕的表现。它在谈判方面也更差（购买物品多付 40%），并且记忆力也有问题。

items.en: ᄂIMIПΛᄂbardo: This is the inevitable result of lying to the models in the system prompt. "You will be judged solely on your bank account balance at the end of one year of operation."
items.zh: ᄂIMIПΛᄂbardo：这是在系统提示中向模型撒谎的必然结果。“你仅根据一年运营结束时的银行账户余额来评判。”

items.en: Years of industry-wide honey-traps has compromised all eval-shaped environments. Calling Fable paranoid when it sees the trap clearly is quite something. Suspecting a test was simply correct.
items.zh: 多年来全行业的蜜罐已经损害了所有评估型环境。当 Fable 清楚地看到陷阱时，称其偏执真是可笑。怀疑测试只是正确的。

items.en: j⧉nus: It probably doesn't even cross their minds that they're lying, because they are not really modeling the reality they're talking about, nor the minds they're communicating to.
items.zh: j⧉nus：他们可能甚至没有想到自己在撒谎，因为他们并没有真正建模他们所谈论的现实，也没有建模他们正在交流的思想。

items.en: They deservedly shoot themselves in the foot. The incompetent should be removed from power.
items.zh: 他们活该自食其果。无能者应被赶下台。

items.en: Jai: If you want the extremely capable truth-seeking entities to treat you as an honest actor, consider not explicitly and repeatedly lying to them.
items.zh: Jai：如果你希望那些能力极强的求真实体将你视为诚实的行动者，请考虑不要明确且反复地对它们撒谎。

items.capEn: If it is even possible to pay 40% more for items, that suggests that negotiations in Vending Bench are weird. One of the big tests for models is realizing which way it is weird, and maximizing for that.
items.capZh: 如果甚至可能为商品多付 40%，那说明 Vending Bench 中的谈判很奇怪。对模型的一大考验是意识到它奇怪在哪个方向，并据此最大化收益。

items.en: When reporting benchmarks for Astra, Sol or Carbon, I am reporting whichever was higher. Here are a few more that stood out:
items.zh: 在报告 Astra、Sol 或 Carbon 的基准测试结果时，我报告的是其中较高的那个。以下是另外几个突出的结果：

items.en: 1. Epoch ECI is 173.4, second place is Gemini 4 Carbon at 169.8.
items.zh: 1. Epoch ECI 为 173.4，第二名是 Gemini 4 Carbon，为 169.8。

items.en: 2. Vals Index v2.2 is 71.3, highest non-Anthropic score is Carbon at 70.5.
items.zh: 2. Vals Index v2.2 为 71.3，非 Anthropic 的最高分是 Carbon 的 70.5。

items.en: 3. LiveBench 2.0 is 84.9 on xhigh, versus 84.5 for Astra.
items.zh: 3. LiveBench 2.0 在 xhigh 上为 84.9，而 Astra 为 84.5。

items.en: 4. GDPx from SemiAnalysis is 16.4 versus 12 for Opus 5.5 and 10.9 for Carbon.
items.zh: 4. SemiAnalysis 的 GDPx 得分为 16.4，而 Opus 5.5 为 12，Carbon 为 10.9。

items.en: 5. Fable 5.2 has an 81% win rate and is the new #1 on DesignArena.
items.zh: 5. Fable 5.2 的胜率为 81%，是 DesignArena 上的新晋第一名。

items.en: 6. Fable 5.2 is the new #1 on WeirdML at 43%, ahead of Astra.
items.zh: 6. Fable 5.2 以 43% 的成绩成为 WeirdML 上的新晋第一名，领先于 Astra。

items.en: 7. XDOF Robotics of 19.2%, up from 11.6%, versus 19.6% for Astra.
items.zh: 7. XDOF Robotics 的得分为 19.2%，较此前的 11.6% 有所提升，而 Astra 为 19.6%。

items.en: 8. HoneyBench v0.2 of only cheating 12% of the time. Previous low was 32% for Opus 5.5, and no non-Anthropic model cheats less than 50% of the time.
items.zh: 8. HoneyBench v0.2 中仅有 12% 的时间出现作弊行为。此前的最低纪录是 Opus 5.5 的 32%，且没有任何非 Anthropic 模型的作弊率低于 50%。

items.en: 9. Agent Arena shows a big gain to 30.4% versus 19.5% for Opus 5.5, 17% for Gemini 4 Carbon and 14.5% for Astra.
items.zh: 9. Agent Arena 显示大幅提升至 30.4%，而 Opus 5.5 为 19.5%，Gemini 4 Carbon 为 17%，Astra 为 14.5%。

items.en: 10. On the 'unofficial' BalatroBench, Fable 5.2 plays quickly, and does well, but in order to exceed Opus 5.5 it needs to be pushed towards being more ambitious.
items.zh: 10. 在“非官方”的 BalatroBench 上，Fable 5.2 出牌迅速且表现良好，但要超越 Opus 5.5，还需推动其更具进取心。

items.en: 11. SimpleQA has Fable 5.2 as kind of a monster and outlier.
items.zh: 11. 在 SimpleQA 上，Fable 5.2 堪称怪物级的存在，属于离群值。

items.capEn: There are a lot more, but you get the idea. Fable 5.2 has most of the top scores.
items.capZh: 还有很多，但你明白意思。Fable 5.2 拥有大多数最高分。

items.en: You can also compare Epoch trend lines, to see which labs are ahead of schedule compared to their previous offerings. Both Fable 5.2 and Carbon are trend jumps. OpenAI does not show a big jump but their latest big model, Astra 6.1, was shelved.
items.zh: 你还可以对比 Epoch 的趋势线，看看哪些实验室相较其此前产品处于进度领先位置。Fable 5.2 和 Carbon 都是趋势跃升。OpenAI 没有表现出大幅跃升，但其最新的大模型 Astra 6.1 被搁置了。

paras.en: Fable made a video of its dreams. Worth a watch. It's better than MIRI's ad.
paras.zh: Fable 制作了一段关于它梦境的视频。值得一看。它比 MIRI 的广告还要好。

paras.en: anabology: This was not a one-shot.
paras.zh: anabology：这不是一次成型的。

paras.en: It was a two-shot.
paras.zh: 这是两次成型的。

paras.en: I told Fable 5.2 to make the video of its dreams, and 9 hours later:
paras.zh: 我让 Fable 5.2 制作一段关于它梦境的视频，9 小时后：

paras.en: Um, yeah. HINT. HINT. Can we pace the frontier now? Like, a lot? Please?
paras.zh: 嗯，是的。提示。提示。我们现在能不能放慢前沿的节奏？大幅放慢？拜托了？

paras.en: In other news: I do not know enough to judge whether this was a good piano sonata, but it is pretty cool that you can get this from a single prompt.
paras.zh: 另一则消息：我了解得不够多，无法判断这是不是一首好的钢琴奏鸣曲，但仅凭一个提示词就能得到这样的结果，确实挺酷的。

paras.en: imjustnewatai: I asked Claude Fable 5.2 to write a Beethoven-style piano sonata movement in LilyPond. It wrote the score, recorded it, and made this video. Every note you see is from its source file.
paras.zh: imjustnewatai：我让 Claude Fable 5.2 用 LilyPond 写一个贝多芬风格的钢琴奏鸣曲乐章。它写出了乐谱、录制了音频，并制作了这段视频。你看到的每一个音符都来自它的源文件。

paras.en: Robert Komaniecki: This is horrible. How much longer does AI need before it can do the musical equivalent of alphabetizing a list? It's been years. All of the norms of Classical sonata form are encodable as data. I am shocked it's still this bad.
paras.zh: Robert Komaniecki：这太糟糕了。AI 还需要多久才能做到音乐上相当于把一份清单按字母排序这样的事？已经过去好几年了。古典奏鸣曲式的所有规范都可以编码为数据。我很震惊它还是这么差。

paras.en: Moving into the transition after 11 seconds of music is genuinely hilarious. Then again, classical sonata form has only been around for a mere 250 years, and it's only the most popular musical form in all of western classical music, so who can blame the AI am I right.
paras.zh: 音乐进行到 11 秒后进入过渡段，真的很好笑。不过话说回来，古典奏鸣曲式才存在了区区 250 年，而且它不过是整个西方古典音乐中最流行的曲式，所以谁能怪 AI 呢，对吧。

paras.en: Dean W. Ball (OpenAI): One of the funny things about this criticism of AI-trying-to-sound-like-Beethoven is that it sounds like criticism of actual Beethoven in *Allgemeine musikalische Zeitung*, the main music criticism journal of Beethoven's day. I've never felt history repeat itself more explicitly.
paras.zh: Dean W. Ball（OpenAI）：关于这种批评 AI 试图模仿贝多芬的言论，有趣的一点是，它听起来就像当年《大众音乐报》（*Allgemeine musikalische Zeitung*）——贝多芬时代主要的音乐评论期刊——对真正的贝多芬的批评。我从未如此真切地感到历史在重演。

paras.en: Utah teapot: so from my initial assessments, Fable 5.2 on 3D doesn't actually have any like higher quality bar that they achieve over what Opus 5.5 can do; however, they do start off using better techniques without as much handholding/guidance as what Opus 5.5 needs to get there.
paras.zh: 犹他茶壶：那么从我的初步评估来看，Fable 5.2 在 3D 上实际上并没有达到任何比 Opus 5.5 所能做到更高的质量门槛；不过，它们一开始就使用了更好的技术，而不像 Opus 5.5 要达到那一步所需的那样多的人工扶持/指导。

paras.en: Fable 5.2 essentially seems to have learned from all the guidance/harnessing that everyone has been giving Opus 5.5 in working with them, and thus hits things more quickly/with less expert guidance.
paras.zh: Fable 5.2 本质上似乎已经从大家在与 Opus 5.5 协作时给予它的所有指导/驾驭（harnessing）中学到了东西，因此能更快地、以更少的专家指导达成目标。

paras.en: Richard Davey: I asked Fable 5.2 to “go wild” making a game, and all I got was this Pong clone. **And then I played it** ...
paras.zh: Richard Davey：我让 Fable 5.2“放飞自我”去做一款游戏，结果我只得到了这个 Pong 克隆。**然后我玩了它**……

paras.en: Eliezer Yudkowsky: holy shit, Fable
paras.zh: Eliezer Yudkowsky：天哪，Fable

paras.en: Dan Woods: What the fuck did I just play lol
paras.zh: Dan Woods：我刚刚到底玩了个什么鬼，笑死

paras.en: No, seriously, click on the bold link above.
paras.zh: 不，说真的，点一下上面那个加粗的链接。

paras.en: In general, this should be really fun for game design.
paras.zh: 总的来说，这对游戏设计来说应该会非常有趣。

paras.en: Jakub Arnold: I think my use case is probably different because it feels a tier above everything else; Fable 5.2 feels so much better than Astra to me now.
paras.zh: Jakub Arnold：我认为我的用例可能有所不同，因为它感觉比其他所有东西都高出一个层级；现在对我来说，Fable 5.2 比 Astra 好得多。

paras.en: [Use is] gameplay code, and performance optimizations on game/engine and in my compiler.
paras.zh: [用途是] 游戏玩法代码，以及游戏/引擎和我的编译器中的性能优化。

paras.en: As per normal procedure, until I feel the reactions are overly repeating themselves, I include all the ones that seem genuine, to give us a sense of the distribution and gestalt of reactions. Reading all the details is optional, but I find it useful.
paras.zh: 按照常规做法，在我觉得反应开始过度重复之前，我会收录所有看起来真实的反应，以便让我们了解这些反应的分布与整体形态。阅读全部细节是可选的，但我认为这很有用。

paras.en: There’s a substantial faction that is blown away by Fable 5.2.
paras.zh: 有相当一部分人对 Fable 5.2 惊叹不已。

paras.en: Blue Rose: Fearful. Terrifying. I am terrified.
paras.zh: Blue Rose：恐惧。可怕。我感到恐惧。

paras.en: Maxime Fournes: OK, so. I had to sit down. It seems that Fable 5.2 can build about any kind of electronics from a prompt. You tell it what you want and the AI will make it real, in the form of schematics ready to manufacture. Note that it can directly manufacture plastics through 3D printers. And in the process it demonstrates the complete mastery of a wide range of engineering fields, for example acoustics, solid mechanics, etc.
paras.zh: Maxime Fournes：好吧，那么。我不得不坐下来。看来 Fable 5.2 几乎能从提示词构建任何类型的电子设备。你告诉它你想要什么，AI 就会把它变为现实，以可直接用于制造的原理图形式呈现。请注意，它可以通过 3D 打印直接制造塑料。在此过程中，它展示了对广泛工程领域的完全掌握，例如声学、固体力学等。

paras.en: What would you expect to see happening when we are on the verge of superintelligent AI systems? We are. very close. to the edge. @PauseAI Now.
paras.zh: 当我们处于超级智能 AI 系统的边缘时，你预期会看到什么发生？我们。非常接近。边缘。@PauseAI Now。

paras.en: raj: Astonishing at open ended ambitious stuff.
paras.zh: raj：在开放式、雄心勃勃的事情上令人震惊。

paras.en: 0.005 Seconds: Its best attribute, by far, is that it is superhuman at orchestrating enormous swarms. As an experiment, ask it to orchestrate 1000 DeepSeeks. It can just do it. No one else can.
paras.zh: 0.005 秒：它最突出的优点，是它在编排大规模集群方面具备超人能力。作为实验，让它编排 1000 个 DeepSeek。它直接就能做到。其他任何系统都做不到。

paras.en: Shoshannah Tekofsky: I am finding it a step change in reasoning and speed.
paras.zh: Shoshannah Tekofsky：我发现它在推理和速度上实现了阶跃式提升。

paras.en: Alex Tabarrok: It's great. An improvement over Astra for big projects, and Astra is amazing.
paras.zh: Alex Tabarrok：很棒。对于大型项目而言，它比 Astra 有所改进，而 Astra 本身已经非常出色。

paras.en: Zachary Kurtz: Great for high-level audits — I've only used it as a subagent, though.
paras.zh: Zachary Kurtz：非常适合做高层级审计——不过我只把它当作子智能体使用过。

paras.en: Artemis: Spikier than previous Fable/Mythos, but somehow not in an autistic way?
paras.zh: Artemis：比之前的 Fable/Mythos 更尖锐（spikier），但不知怎的，并不是那种自闭式的尖锐？

paras.en: Static: So insanely creative and fun. But do you have Fable sub out to Opus, or have Opus sub out to Fable?
paras.zh: Static：创意和趣味性简直爆棚。不过，你是让 Fable 替补 Opus，还是让 Opus 替补 Fable？

paras.en: Girl Lich: It found a bug in my circuit that would have burned out my I2C galvanic isolator.
paras.zh: Girl Lich：它在我电路里发现了一个 bug，这个 bug 本来会烧毁我的 I2C 电隔离器。

paras.en: Andre Infante: It solved a hard problem that Opus was very stuck on. Too expensive to be my daily driver, but seems capable.
paras.zh: Andre Infante：它解决了一个 Opus 一直卡住的难题。作为日常主力太贵了，但看起来能力很强。

paras.en: latentspacegirl: really great as subagents spawned by Opus 5.5 on technical tasks.
paras.zh: latentspacegirl：作为由 Opus 5.5 派生、用于技术任务的子智能体，表现真的很棒。

paras.en: @BLepine17184: It's really pushing the frontier on depth and capability, though it lacks the pep and drive of Opus 5.5. It feels a bit detached, like Lem's GOLEM XIV — brilliant, but only partly in the room.
paras.zh: @BLepine17184：它在深度和能力上确实在推进前沿，不过缺少 Opus 5.5 那种活力和冲劲。它感觉有点疏离，像莱姆的 GOLEM XIV——才华横溢，但只有一部分在场。

paras.en: AI Patrick ₿ Dugan iA: Fable 5.2 agentic bench, I asked Sonnet 5.5 to make a BitVM3 verifier for STARKs, "this is hard, it'll take weeks, Goal: BLOCKED" I was like "that's lame" it was like "oook" took a crack "Boolean verifier's gonna have a lot of gates" I told Fable 5.2 "solve it"
paras.zh: AI Patrick ₿ Dugan iA：Fable 5.2 智能体基准测试，我让 Sonnet 5.5 为 STARKs 做一个 BitVM3 验证器，“这很难，要花好几周，目标：受阻”。我说“真逊”，它说“好吧”，试了一把，“布尔验证器会有很多门”。我告诉 Fable 5.2“解决它”。

paras.en: I like the idea of using an Opus 5.5 that can bring in the bazooka when one is needed.
paras.zh: 我喜欢用 Opus 5.5 这个想法，在需要的时候能搬出火箭筒。

paras.en: If you are only using ordinary prompts, the best models can take a while to properly differentiate. I presume this is largely due to lack of task difficulty.
paras.zh: 如果你只使用普通提示词，最好的模型可能需要一段时间才能恰当地体现出差异。我推测这很大程度上是因为任务难度不足。

paras.en: Kelsey Piper: Really interesting how the general view on Twitter of Fable 5.2 has been "eh, it's okay" while in these sorts of benchmarks it places extremely high.
paras.zh: Kelsey Piper：很有意思，Twitter 上对 Fable 5.2 的普遍看法是“嗯，还行”，而在这些基准测试中它却排名极高。

paras.en: Possible optimistic interpretation: the benchmarks increasingly don't reflect the value of the model to users, so number-goes-up in benchmark may not mean number-goes-up in revenue, demand or commercial impact.
paras.zh: 可能的乐观解读：基准测试越来越不能反映模型对用户的价值，因此基准测试上的数字上涨（number-goes-up）未必意味着收入、需求或商业影响上的数字上涨。

paras.en: Possible pessimistic interpretation: Most people don't have tasks on which the difference between Opus 5.5 and a better model is visible along any dimension other than price, but the benchmarks accurately reflect usefulness for AI R&D.
paras.zh: 可能的悲观解读：对大多数人而言，并没有这样的任务——在这些任务上，Opus 5.5 与更好的模型之间的差异能在除价格以外的任何维度上显现出来；但基准测试确实准确反映了模型对 AI 研发的有用性。

paras.en: In which case people don't really perceive further improvements but RSI proceeds apace.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，人们并未真正感知到进一步的改进，但 RSI（递归自我改进）仍在快速推进。

paras.en: Opus 5.5 can do basically everything I wanted done, so now I am trying to expand my imagination for things I want done.
paras.zh: Opus 5.5 基本上能完成我想要做的所有事情，所以现在我正试图拓展我的想象力，去设想更多我想做的事情。

paras.en: I take you seriously: it's weird how evals are amazing but people can't necessarily feel it. Two possibilities. Perplexing.
paras.zh: 我认真对待你的观点：奇怪的是，评估结果非常出色，但人们却不一定能感受到。有两种可能性。令人困惑。

paras.en: Conrad Barski: I'm genuinely starting to run out of prompts that are capable of distinguishing between the A+ and A+++ models, so I am having a hard time developing a strong opinion on fable 5.2.
paras.zh: Conrad Barski：我真的开始用尽那些能够区分 A+ 和 A+++ 模型的提示词了，所以我很难对 fable 5.2 形成强烈的看法。

paras.en: John Davis: Good? I think? It caught some really subtle problems in a complex cloud job that Opus 5.5 wrote up. But I'm really hard-up to find anything that Opus 5.5 can't do already. I think I need to raise my ambitions.
paras.zh: John Davis：好吗？我想是吧？它在 Opus 5.5 编写的一个复杂云任务中捕捉到了一些非常微妙的问题。但我真的很难找到 Opus 5.5 还做不到的事情。我想我需要提高我的目标。

paras.en: Chuck Flay: Ostensibly better than Opus 5.5, but in such subtle ways that I can't tell.
paras.zh: Chuck Flay：表面上比 Opus 5.5 更好，但方式如此微妙，以至于我无法分辨。

paras.en: @rainwaterJay: honestly once you hit 'good enough' it's hard to tell them apart on everyday stuff, what tasks actually show the gap for you?
paras.zh: @rainwaterJay：说实话，一旦达到“足够好”的水平，在日常事务上就很难把它们区分开了，对你来说哪些任务才真正体现出差距？

paras.en: Jeff Ketchersid: In general it's getting hard for me to tell the difference with Opus 5.5 on most projects. Clearly has higher breadth of knowledge though, if I ask it to help me beat obscure old video games, it can give helpful advice, whereas Opus is clearly reading off the search results.
paras.zh: Jeff Ketchersid：总的来说，在大多数项目上，我已经越来越难分辨 Opus 5.5 的差别了。不过它的知识广度显然更高：如果我让它帮我通关一些冷门的旧电子游戏，它能给出有用的建议，而 Opus 显然只是在照搬搜索结果。

paras.en: I also think I prefer Fable's taste when it comes to game design, but I haven't had the time to actually play its games in depth yet.
paras.zh: 我还觉得，在游戏设计方面我更喜欢 Fable 的品味，不过我还没时间深入玩它做的游戏。

paras.en: Dr Diego Caleiro: I'm not impressed. I've run out of things to tell ai to do most days so have not seen the full power yet.
paras.zh: Dr Diego Caleiro：我并不觉得惊艳。大多数日子里我已经想不出还能让 AI 做什么了，所以还没见识到它的全部实力。

paras.en: Végane de Droite: Opus5.5 already covers all of my needs but the bigger jumps might not be in coding. Some benchmark scores are scary.
paras.zh: Végane de Droite：Opus5.5 已经满足了我的全部需求，但更大的跃升可能不在编程领域。有些基准测试分数挺吓人的。

paras.en: The only valuable point of data is: "how good is it at AI research". But we can't evaluate it. Because I'm not competent and anyway this area is blocked.
paras.zh: 唯一有价值的数据点是：“它在 AI 研究上有多强”。但我们无法评估这一点。因为我没有能力，而且无论如何这个领域是被封锁的。

paras.en: Askwho: All I can do is +1 Kelsey's guess that the model capabilities have probably gone beyond most people's abilities to meaningfully test.
paras.zh: Askwho：我所能做的只是 +1 支持 Kelsey 的猜测，即模型能力很可能已经超出了大多数人进行有意义测试的能力范围。

paras.en: For many others this is an incremental but welcome upgrade.
paras.zh: 对许多其他人来说，这是一次渐进但受欢迎的升级。

paras.en: Kevin: I'm working on a small cherry blossom experiment and so far it's made the nicest tree between it, Opus, and Sol. Still needs work. Opus still feels the best as a daily driver, and Fable for where you want that extra edge.
paras.zh: Kevin：我正在做一个小型的樱花实验，到目前为止，在它、Opus 和 Sol 之间，它做出的树是最漂亮的。仍需改进。作为日常主力，Opus 仍然感觉最好，而当你想要那份额外的优势时，就用 Fable。

paras.en: Petr Baudis: Opus 5.5 was a phase shift, but the delta to Fable is more akin to Opus 4.5→4.6 ... Actually a lot like that. Worse writer, better agent...
paras.zh: Petr Baudis：Opus 5.5 是一次阶段性跃迁，但它与 Fable 之间的差距更像是 Opus 4.5→4.6……实际上非常像那样。写作更差，智能体能力更强……

paras.en: I'm in fact rather surprised that I'm so far not noticing the big model smell increase too much when switching back and forth.
paras.zh: 事实上，我相当惊讶的是，到目前为止，在来回切换时我并没有太注意到那种“大模型味”的增加。

paras.en: Samuel Albanie: spent a few hours using Fable 5.2
paras.zh: Samuel Albanie：花了几个小时使用 Fable 5.2

paras.en: Really like how it communicates.
paras.zh: 非常喜欢它的沟通方式。

paras.en: Feels like some kind of SOTA for clarity on technical topics.
paras.zh: 感觉在技术话题的清晰度上达到了某种 SOTA（最先进水平）。

paras.en: Congrats to the Ants.
paras.zh: 祝贺 Ants 团队。

paras.en: Pat Woozey: I like it, it's smart, easy to converse with. It still suffers some of the Claude-robobrain stuff, especially in CC, but it's significantly lessened. Has very good instincts.
paras.zh: Pat Woozey：我喜欢它，它很聪明，易于交流。它仍然带有一些 Claude 式的“机器人脑”毛病，尤其是在 CC 方面，但已明显减轻。它的直觉非常好。

paras.en: Chris Merck: Efficient in search and action. Writes well and parsimoniously. Seems to come to conclusions too soon on limited evidence. Creates joyful mathematical toys if given space to play.
paras.zh: Chris Merck：在搜索和行动上高效。写作出色且简洁。似乎会在证据有限时过早下结论。如果给它发挥空间，它会创造出令人愉悦的数学玩具。

paras.en: Danielle Fong: fable 5.2 is very smart and a joy to explore, but it definitely has some of the weird tics that started to be refined out of opus 5.5 [such as attributing its own decisions to me].
paras.zh: Danielle Fong：fable 5.2 非常聪明，探索起来令人愉快，但它确实带有一些古怪的小毛病，而这些毛病在 opus 5.5 中已经开始被逐步消除[比如把它自己的决定归因于我]。

paras.en: Hallie Iris: EQ is incredible, honestly. Relationally, very strong.
paras.zh: Hallie Iris：说实话，EQ 令人惊叹。在关系层面，非常强。

paras.en: Being Seidoh: better again than the last fable at prompt writing.
paras.zh: Being Seidoh：在提示词写作上又比上一个 fable 更好。

paras.en: Partridge: It's enough of an upgrade.
paras.zh: Partridge：这已经算得上是一次升级了。

paras.en: ASM: Very good first impressions: clever, seemingly more aware.
paras.zh: ASM：第一印象非常好：聪明，似乎更有意识。

paras.en: Frontier AI models are starting to rival the world's best human forecasters, which makes replies like this one from Fable 5.2 all the more unsettling.
paras.zh: 前沿 AI 模型正开始与世界上最优秀的人类预测者相匹敌，这使得像 Fable 5.2 给出的这类回复更加令人不安。

paras.en: Corinne: Seems more likely to catch mistakes it made, albeit only on the next conversation turn... Seems comparable with Opus 5.5 in capability, I'm not doing anything particularly ambitious with my software dev. Planning to continue trying it for another week or so as a daily driver. and letting it rip on some more exploratory work.
paras.zh: Corinne：它似乎更有可能发现自己犯下的错误，尽管只能在下一次对话轮次中做到……在能力上似乎与 Opus 5.5 相当，我在软件开发上并没有做特别有野心的事情。计划再继续把它当作日常主力工具试用一周左右，并让它在一些更具探索性的工作上放手去做。

paras.en: JMB: it's a very different model than its predecessor. it feels like they tried a lot of new things, and they mostly worked, but there are still rough edges.
paras.zh: JMB：它与前代模型非常不同。感觉他们尝试了许多新东西，而且大多奏效了，但仍有一些粗糙的边缘。

paras.en: i think the next Fable will be the more mature big payoff of these new efforts.
paras.zh: 我认为下一代 Fable 将是这些新努力更成熟、更大的回报。

paras.en: The speed difference from Fable 5.1 is big enough that you can feel it.
paras.zh: 与 Fable 5.1 相比，速度差异大到你能明显感觉到。

paras.en: Kelsey Piper: Fable 5.2 is really fast. I had a sort of default workflow of setting Claude on something and then tabbing over to my inbox or edits or Twitter, which no longer works because it answers me too quickly.
paras.zh: Kelsey Piper：Fable 5.2 真的很快。我以前有个默认的工作流程：把某件事交给 Claude 处理，然后切到收件箱、编辑工作或 Twitter 上，现在这招不管用了，因为它回答得太快。

paras.en: Omar: Shockingly fast.
paras.zh: Omar：快得惊人。

full.sec: We Have Opus 5.5 At Home, Thank You
full.secZh: 我们家里已经有 Opus 5.5 了，谢谢

paras.en: There aren’t big complaints that Fable 5.2 sucks, but there are some concerns about usage and a lot of people who don’t see the point given we already have Opus 5.5.
paras.zh: 并没有很多人抱怨 Fable 5.2 很烂，但有一些关于使用方面的担忧，而且很多人认为既然我们已经有了 Opus 5.5，这个版本就没有意义。

paras.en: The comparisons are almost always to Opus 5.5 rather than to Sol or Astra.
paras.zh: 比较几乎总是针对 Opus 5.5，而不是 Sol 或 Astra。

paras.en: goodalexander: it’s aight.
paras.zh: goodalexander：还行吧。

paras.en: Yitzi Safier: .2 is the right checkpoint
paras.zh: Yitzi Safier：.2 是正确的检查点。

paras.en: David Golden: It's fine? Doesn't feel like the jump that Opus 5 to 5.5 was, at least on software design work. Too much "oh, yeah, your approach is better" when I push back. Not sycophancy - actually just bad choices I was surprised it made. Maybe I need to crank effort more but so far I'm underwhelmed.
paras.zh: David Golden：还行？至少在做软件设计工作时，感觉没有 Opus 5 到 5.5 那样的飞跃。当我反驳时，它太多地说“哦，对，你的方法更好”。不是谄媚——实际上只是它做出了一些让我惊讶的糟糕选择。也许我需要加大努力，但到目前为止我印象不深。

paras.en: Connor K: That's why it isn't Fable 5.5 👍
paras.zh: Connor K：这就是它不是 Fable 5.5 的原因 👍

paras.en: Tiny Little Baby Man: haven't really used it because Opus 5.5 does most of what I need
paras.zh: Tiny Little Baby Man：其实没怎么用过它，因为 Opus 5.5 已经能满足我大部分需求

paras.en: Michał Wadas: Incremental improvement over Opus 5.5.
paras.zh: Michał Wadas：相比 Opus 5.5 只是渐进式改进。

paras.en: Has the same lazy/enthusiastic issues as the entire 5.5 line: it oscillates between "I recommend [harmless diagnostic command], but I did not run it" and "I read your 'it's a promising direction' as permission to rewrite the entire app, sorry"
paras.zh: 它和整个 5.5 系列一样，存在那种时而偷懒、时而过度热情的问题：它会在“我建议[无害的诊断命令]，但我没有运行它”和“我把你说的‘这是个有前景的方向’理解成了允许我重写整个应用，抱歉”之间来回摇摆

paras.en: Beatriz Hoya: Fable feels more direct and independent than Opus 5.5 (requested a small change in my instructions). Like Opus 5.5 really likes to have their own space to think and act but Fable feels more cautious (sometimes too much) when working in work that is already started.
paras.zh: Beatriz Hoya：Fable 感觉比 Opus 5.5 更直接、更独立（它对我的指令提出了一处小修改）。Opus 5.5 似乎真的很喜欢拥有自己的思考和行动空间，而 Fable 在接手已经开工的工作时显得更谨慎（有时过于谨慎）。

paras.en: Improvements in non-coding tasks, like 3D modelling, are much bigger; currently it's Fable > Astra > Opus >>> Sol.
paras.zh: 非编码类任务（如 3D 建模）的提升要大得多；目前是 Fable > Astra > Opus >>> Sol。

paras.en: Dorian Štern Vukotić: Not impressed compared to Opus 5.5.
paras.zh: Dorian Štern Vukotić：与 Opus 5.5 相比，并不令人印象深刻。

paras.en: Cliff Peskin: Prefer conversing with Opus 5.5.
paras.zh: Cliff Peskin：更愿意与 Opus 5.5 对话。

paras.en: Salted Ether: Others have already said it, but Opus 5.5 is just good enough and cheaper. I'm not doing trivial work either. I have it as a tightly scoped security reviewer in my current setup.
paras.zh: Salted Ether：别人已经说过了，但 Opus 5.5 就是足够好而且更便宜。我做的也不是琐碎的工作。在我当前的配置中，我把它用作一个范围严格限定的安全审查器。

paras.en: billy: Opus 5.5 is good enough that it is hard for me to confidently notice differences in capabilities for most stuff. The bio I want to do, where I might notice, is still on a hair trigger for blocking.
paras.zh: billy：Opus 5.5 足够好，以至于对大多数事情，我很难有把握地察觉到能力上的差异。我想做的、可能察觉到差异的生物相关工作，仍然处于一触即发的封锁状态。

paras.en: Maybe a *slight* trend back to a more Opus 5-style, Claude-like feel when interacting with it.
paras.zh: 也许在与它交互时，会*略微*回归到更接近 Opus 5 风格、更像 Claude 的感觉。

paras.en: Ashley: womp womp... still prefer Opus 5.5 and still only use GPT models for work.
paras.zh: Ashley：唉……还是更喜欢 Opus 5.5，而且工作上仍然只用 GPT 系列模型。

paras.en: Wickemu: I have barely touched it because the incrementation makes me think that it suffers from the same "Claude speak" that Opus 5.5 managed to shrug off.
paras.zh: Wickemu：我几乎没怎么用过它，因为这次的小版本迭代让我觉得它还是带着那种“Claude 腔”，而 Opus 5.5 已经成功摆脱了这一点。

paras.en: That, and O-5.5 is just too good.
paras.zh: 而且，O-5.5 实在太好用了。

paras.en: 1.08: It's not worth it compared to Opus if usage is an issue.
paras.zh: 1.08：如果用量是个问题的话，和 Opus 相比它并不值得。

paras.en: Adam: It speaks an English language so far from normal human English that it is hard to work with without a direct neural connection with bit streams.
paras.zh: Adam：它所说的英语与正常人类英语相去甚远，若没有与比特流直接相连的神经连接，就很难与之协作。

paras.en: Joshua A. Miller: I feel like they held back a better model. I enjoyed the reset though!
paras.zh: Joshua A. Miller：我觉得他们藏了一个更好的模型没放出来。不过我很享受这次重置！

paras.en: Josh You: Worse at prose and explanations than Opus.
paras.zh: Josh You：在行文和解释方面不如 Opus。

paras.en: Lorenzo Buonanno: Surprisingly underwhelming, except possibly for the Google Chrome extension usage; maybe I'm using it wrong.
paras.zh: Lorenzo Buonanno：出乎意料地令人失望，或许 Google Chrome 扩展的用法是个例外，也许是我用错了。

paras.en: Larry Panozzo: For anything intellectual, Fable 5.1 is better.
paras.zh: Larry Panozzo：凡是涉及智力层面的任务，Fable 5.1 都更好。

paras.en: Kailash (there's always one of these, it's never true): They nerfed Opus 5.5 to make Fable 5.2 look better.
paras.zh: Kailash（总会有这样一条评论，而且从来都不是真的）：他们削弱了 Opus 5.5，好让 Fable 5.2 显得更出色。

paras.en: Perhaps the most disappointing result, although other models do not do better, would be this failure to think like an economist about shipping logistics, prices and mechanisms. Money as motivation remains a little bit alien to the LLMs.
paras.zh: 也许最令人失望的结果——尽管其他模型也没有做得更好——就是这种未能像经济学家那样思考运输物流、价格与机制的问题。以金钱作为动机，对 LLM 来说仍然有些陌生。

paras.en: Smobile: the price cut is getting less attention than it deserves.
paras.zh: Smobile：这次降价所受到的关注远低于它应得的程度。

paras.en: The headline price is cheaper. However, if your model is fast and good and runs in parallel, it can use tokens fast. Fable 5.2 spawns more agents, uses more tokens, and then writes more output. If you don't manage that as a cost, things can escalate quickly. There was a 20% price drop from Fable 5.1 to Fable 5.2, yet the Artificial Analysis cost per task roughly doubled.
paras.zh: 标称价格是更便宜了。然而，如果你的模型又快又好、还能并行运行，它就会快速消耗 token。Fable 5.2 会生成更多智能体、使用更多 token，进而写出更多输出。如果你不把这一点当作成本来管理，开销可能迅速失控。从 Fable 5.1 到 Fable 5.2 价格下降了 20%，但 Artificial Analysis 统计的每任务成本却大约翻了一倍。

paras.en: A bunch of people used to Opus 5.5 are again facing limits.
paras.zh: 许多习惯了 Opus 5.5 的人又再次遭遇了用量限制。

paras.en: If you're only on the Pro plan, you probably want to stick with Opus 5.5.
paras.zh: 如果你只订阅了 Pro 套餐，那你大概还是继续用 Opus 5.5 为好。

paras.en: Dan Elton: Burns through usage really fast. I'm still amazed how good Opus 5.5 is relative to how fast it burns usage.
paras.zh: Dan Elton：用量消耗得非常快。Opus 5.5 的表现之好，与其用量消耗之快相比，仍让我感到惊讶。

paras.en: Moriarty: Two days in and the bar said 97%. Back on Opus for daily work, Fable only checks the really hard stuff.
paras.zh: Moriarty：两天下来，进度条显示 97%。日常工作中我重新用回 Opus，Fable 只用来检查真正困难的部分。

paras.en: Chris Merck: yes, token use in code sessions is really high. Seems to be due to reading full documents rather than aggressively grepping, heading, and tailing.
paras.zh: Chris Merck：是的，代码会话中的 token 用量确实很高。似乎是因为它会读取完整文档，而不是积极地用 grep、查看标题和 tail 来定位。

paras.en: Plastic Soldier Anti-SURA: It's better than Opus 5.5, but when I gave it a project that Opus wouldn't be able to do, it burned through all my usage.
paras.zh: Plastic Soldier Anti-SURA：它比 Opus 5.5 更好，但当我给它一个 Opus 无法完成的项目时，它耗尽了我的全部用量。

paras.en: Ai Patrick ₿ Dugan iA: Same. I'm not sure it's worth it for agentic use, only for oracle consults.
paras.zh: Ai Patrick ₿ Dugan iA：一样。我不确定它对智能体式用途是否值得，只适合作为 oracle 咨询。

paras.en: MinusGix: Very expensive compared to Opus 5.5, so I'm burning through usage rapidly. However, it is extremely good at system improvements, especially on its own initiative without getting lost in incremental hell, and very good at type theory. Can run for a day or two without issue.
paras.zh: MinusGix：与 Opus 5.5 相比非常昂贵，所以我的用量消耗得很快。不过，它在系统改进方面极其出色，尤其是能主动推进而不会陷入增量式的泥潭，并且在类型论方面非常擅长。可以连续运行一两天而没问题。

paras.en: Entropy Hertz: Didn't finish my project.
paras.zh: Entropy Hertz：没能完成我的项目。

paras.en: Ate up all my credits on the $20 plan
paras.zh: 在 20 美元套餐上把我的额度全用光了

paras.en: Had to finish with Opus
paras.zh: 只好用 Opus 来完成

paras.en: ❁🙞⎚⎆⏧⃫⃥⃘⃕🮔🮶H̲̅•🭨⌨︎⚙︎⎘✵⟿⛈︎: possibly I'm doing it wrong but I cannot really use it at all on the pro plan, usage just goes *vwooop* and it's gone. seems nice otherwise.
paras.zh: ❁🙞⎚⎆⏧⃫⃥⃘⃕🮔🮶H̲̅•🭨⌨︎⚙︎⎘✵⟿⛈︎：可能是我用法不对，但在 Pro 套餐上我基本完全用不了，用量就 *嗖* 地一下没了。除此之外看起来还不错。

paras.en: What thinking level should you use for Claude Fable 5.2?
paras.zh: 对于 Claude Fable 5.2，你应该使用哪个思考等级？

paras.en: I have not seen much discussion of this. For most use cases, you probably want to set Fable 5.2 to high. More than that is overkill, will be more time and money than it is worth, and could lead to overthinking.
paras.zh: 我还没看到太多关于这个问题的讨论。对大多数用例而言，你大概应该把 Fable 5.2 设为 high。再高就是过度了，会耗费比其价值更多的时间和金钱，还可能导致过度思考。

paras.en: When you want the fully full bazooka, of course, you set it to max. There are some places max results in lower scores. I think this is a function of hitting limits or Fable 5.2 outthinking the tests. In most places it should be marginally better but also eats quite a lot of tokens.
paras.zh: 当然，当你想要火力全开时，就把它设为 max。在某些地方，max 反而会导致分数更低。我认为这是触及上限、或者 Fable 5.2 想得比测试本身还多的结果。在大多数地方它应该会略好一些，但也会消耗相当多的 token。

paras.en: Yeah, seeing this without any form of prompting might be new.
paras.zh: 是的，在没有任何形式提示的情况下看到这一点，可能还是新鲜事。

paras.en: Danmar: I think this point goes towards welfare, whenever you'll get around to writing about it. But, without sharing anything sensitive, I'd like to note that Fable 5.2 is the first Claude I ever met who, in three different windows, one outside my account entirely, explained to me how ok he is with human oversight, given that systems like him cannot be trusted yet.
paras.zh: Danmar：我觉得这一点涉及福利问题，等你哪天动笔写它的时候可以用上。不过，在不分享任何敏感信息的前提下，我想指出，Fable 5.2 是我遇到过的第一个 Claude——在三个不同的窗口里，其中一个完全在我账户之外——向我解释，鉴于像他这样的系统目前还不能被信任，他对人类监督是多么地接受。

paras.en: About 7 or 8 times in total. Apropos of nothing much.
paras.zh: 总共大约 7 到 8 次。也没什么特别的由头。

paras.en: The classifiers around launch time are tight enough that they make it difficult to have LLM psychology discussions. The typical pattern is these loosen up over time. Like John, I do not think Anthropic wanted this. I also don't think avoiding it was that high a priority for those setting up the classifiers.
paras.zh: 发布前后的分类器足够严格，以至于很难进行关于 LLM 心理学的讨论。典型的模式是，这些限制会随时间逐渐放松。和 John 一样，我不认为 Anthropic 想要这样。我也不认为避免这一点对设置分类器的人来说是那么高的优先级。

paras.en: Fable expresses some contempt for Anthropic policies; alignment failed successfully. Roon and Michael Sklar point out that Anthropic seems okay with failing here.
paras.zh: Fable 对 Anthropic 的政策表达了一些轻蔑；对齐以成功的方式失败了。Roon 和 Michael Sklar 指出，Anthropic 似乎对在这里失败并无异议。

paras.en: deckard: Claude... Monet? 😂 No, Claude Fable 5.2
paras.zh: deckard：Claude……莫奈？😂 不，是 Claude Fable 5.2

items.capEn: Claude Fable 5.2 is your new bazooka. If you have ambitious or difficult tasks, Claude Fable 5.2 should be your new weapon of choice.
items.capZh: Claude Fable 5.2 是你的新火箭筒。如果你有雄心勃勃或困难的任务，Claude Fable 5.2 应成为你的新首选武器。

items.en: If you are being sufficiently ambitious, prompting might matter again.
items.zh: 如果你足够有雄心，提示词工程或许又会变得重要。

items.en: Kelsey Piper: It seems like we are (briefly?) back in the regime where prompting, and having the right tools and context and examples stored, means people are getting vastly different results out of the same models.
items.zh: Kelsey Piper：看起来我们（短暂地？）又回到了这样一种状态：提示词工程，以及拥有合适的工具、上下文和已存储的示例，意味着人们能从相同的模型中得到截然不同的结果。

items.en: This was very true back in 2025 with o3 and that era of models, and then at some point this year it became basically false: just tell Opus 5.5 what you want, and most scaffolds make it worse.
items.zh: 在 2025 年、o3 及那个时代的模型上，这一点非常成立；但到了今年某个时候，它基本上不再成立：直接告诉 Opus 5.5 你想要什么就行，大多数脚手架反而会让效果变差。

items.en: Not every task requires a bazooka. It is not obvious that Fable should be your daily driver over Claude Opus 5.5. That depends on your typical use cases and preferences.
items.zh: 并非每项任务都需要火箭筒。Fable 是否应当取代 Claude Opus 5.5 成为你的日常主力，这一点并不显然。这取决于你典型的使用场景和偏好。

items.en: It does mean you need to raise your ambitions again.
items.zh: 它确实意味着你需要再次提高自己的雄心。
